description:
The study area takes one recorded blanket disposition covering every record it holds, with the measurement subtree that a committed self-test script reads carved out and retained where it is.

## Background

Each file's outcome is decided rather than open: 9 take the archived location an owning container's run produces; 4 are claimed by a terminal owner outside every archived subtree, so the runs mirror them into the archive and retain the source; 6 take a project-scoped reclassification and stay where they are, two of them under the runtime-fixture carve-out. The blanket call is one decision — a study record follows its owning issue's archival outcome, and a record no terminal owner claims is project-scoped — and the enumeration below states that decision's scope rather than nineteen separate judgements.

The area is close to homogeneous but not uniform: a measurement subtree inside it holds a record that a committed self-test script opens by path at runtime, so that subtree is carved out of the blanket call and retained.

The disposition record is `disposition-study-records.md` inside this epic's canonical artifact directory, `dev/active/8e071e18-dev-artifact-layout`. The record's directory is the canonical artifact directory the command resolves for this epic in the active area rather than a path composed by hand, which makes this epic one of the convention's first consumers. Keeping the record in one document rather than inside each file leaves the historical documents' bytes untouched, for the same reason archival warns about in-content citations instead of rewriting them.
